out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Observed and amendment waiting for corrections.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: HAMEND-2026-00418 NEW HOOD and NEW GRILL

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Observed previous owner permit posted
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. CFM posted new 2026 permit

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw beef on top of cut cabbage in unit # 5
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM relocated cabbage to the upper shelf and raw beef to the bottom shelf.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3- compartment sink and sanitizer bucket with a concentration of 10 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. CFM add more chlorine to 100ppm

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Observed ice machine soiled
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM emptied ice machine and clean, sanitize and air dry during the inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Cut cabbage ( curtido), half & half in unit # 8 at 45, 51F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Cut cabbage ( curtido), half & half from unit # 8

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Observed pupusa mix, cut cabbage (curtido), cooked potato not to be date marked.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM date marked pupusa mix, cut cabbage (curtido), cooked potato.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. Observed no thermometer at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. CFM found the thermometer and make it available for the employees

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths on counters
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.CFM stored wet wiping cloths on sanitizer bucket

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Observed knives store in the crack of the ice machine
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM removed knives from the crack, washed, rinsed and sanitized them and store on them on the counter.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 8. TRUE 2-door display cooler (front) at 43F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM will adjust/repair cooler and won’t store perishable foods until is repair.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level 3-compartment sink is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. CFM will call plumber to fix the 3 compartment sink pluming and add air gap/break in the 3 compartment sink as shows in the diagram provided by the EHS .
